governance_note: State the intended linear algebra operation before translating it into language-specific syntax.
Assert matrix and vector dimensions before and after products, solves, decompositions, and broadcasts.
Document zero-based, one-based, label-based, and query-order-dependent indexing when moving across languages.
Distinguish matrix multiplication, elementwise multiplication, dot products, and broadcasting for each language.
Document dense, sparse, tensor, data-frame, table, matrix-free, row-major, and column-major representations.
Record residuals, condition numbers, rank, determinant, reconstruction error, and tolerances.
Preserve row IDs, column IDs, units, precision, missingness, schemas, and metadata across data exchange.
Treat cross-language agreement as supporting evidence only when assumptions and diagnostics are documented.
